name: How do professionals dry wet carpet and what equipment do they use?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals dry wet carpet and what equipment do they use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals use a multi-step process to dry wet carpet effectively. First, powerful water extraction units remove standing water from the carpet and padding. Next, industrial-strength air movers are strategically placed to circulate air and evaporate moisture. Commercial-grade dehumidifiers then remove moisture from the air, preventing re-absorption and accelerating the drying process. Moisture meters are used throughout to monitor dryness levels in the carpet, padding, and subfloor, ensuring all hidden moisture is detected and eliminated. This comprehensive approach ensures complete drying and prevents secondary damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals use water extraction units, industrial air movers, and commercial dehumidifiers to thoroughly dry wet carpet. Moisture meters ensure all hidden moisture is detected and eliminated.
